title: Report
description: One published article, post or reference page about a movement. We store a link and a short summary written in our own words, never the article text.

id.description: <date>-<outlet-slug>-<4 hex chars of a hash of url+movement>. Also the file name. The same article may be filed under several movements, once each.

archive_url.description: Wayback Machine (or similar) copy, so the link survives link rot.

summary.description: One or two sentences in our own words. Attribute contested claims to whoever made them.

read.description: true if the full article was opened and read when the summary was written; false if it rests on the headline or a snippet.

added.description: Date the entry was added to the index.

drafted_by.description: Who wrote the summary. 'ai' means the AI assistant drafted it and an editor approved it.
